differences: Onboarding trust pills collapse into ellipses at accessibility-large and lose their distinguishing copy.
The conversation safety card compresses while its chip content and the custom message viewport paint over each other.
The disappearing-message prompt truncates its visible action and exposes only a 28-point unlabeled close target.
suggestions: Stack onboarding pills and use intrinsic multi-line height at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes.
Give the safety card intrinsic vertical height and prevent the custom message viewport from drawing outside its assigned slot.
Allow the prompt copy to wrap and expose a labeled 44-point dismiss target.
reasoning: The intended native Nome conversation and onboarding style is recognizable, but large-text layout defects hide meaning and create destructive overlap.
